@Engineering colleagues: User has raised an issue concerning a sample transaction where when the card number (within the transaction receipt) is clicked, it shows no results. Please find the query and details below:

prepare prepared_query(BIGINT) as

SELECT 
T1.StoreNo AS "storeno", 
T1.CashierNo AS "cashierno", 
T1.TransactionID AS "transactionid"
FROM ardm_Header AS T1
WHERE 
(
(T1.TradingDay BETWEEN CAST('2022-09-28T00:00:00' AS DATE) AND CAST('2023-10-27T23:59:59' AS DATE))
)
AND
(T1.TransactionID = $1)
LIMIT 1000;

execute prepared_query(2306010000220528188);
deallocate prepared_query;

From database perspective, we can see the sample account number (screenshot above) linked to various transactions (but not visible in Secure):

User has also advised that the reason why clicking on the card number (within transaction viewer) does not show any results is because someone accidently saved over the links when they had a card # they were running. User also advised that the aforementioned is the most probable cause because when user clicked on “composer” (on the screen where no linked transactions are seen), it shows a card # and 2 stores #’s saved (user shared screenshot below) and advised they had this issue 2 other times in the past where tickets were opened:

Would request if you can kindly review the aforementioned and advise accordingly. Thankyou!

prepare prepared_query(TEXT,TEXT[]) as

SELECT 
T1.StoreNo AS "storeno", 
T1.StoreCashierNO AS "storecashierno", 
T1.POSNo AS "posno", 
T1.TicketNo AS "ticketno", 
T1.EndTransDateTime AS "endtransdatetime", 
T1.TicketAmount AS "ticketamount", 
T1.TransactionID AS "transactionid"
FROM ardm_Header AS T1
LEFT JOIN ardm_Tender AS T2
	ON (T1.TransactionID = T2.TransactionID AND T1.TradingDay = T2.TradingDay) 
WHERE 
(
(T1.TradingDay BETWEEN CAST('2023-03-06T00:00:00' AS DATE) AND CAST('2024-04-05T23:59:59' AS DATE))
)
AND
(
(T2.AccountNumber = $1)
AND 
(T2.TenderType = ANY ($2))
)
ORDER BY "endtransdatetime" DESC
LIMIT 1000;

execute prepared_query('402347******7035',ARRAY['6','10']);
deallocate prepared_query;
